value.rationale: The graded automorphism group is a natural symmetry invariant of the path Artinian graph algebras used in Lefschetz studies. A complete all-dimension classification over every even finite field exposes two characteristic-two endpoint shear directions and multiplies the corresponding odd-characteristic order by q^2. The phenomenon is structural (Frobenius kills cross terms), not an isolated small table, arbitrary slice, or restatement of the characteristic-zero general framework. The exact invariant and normal forms support further finite-field module and orbit studies.
